reason: A configurable DSH status bar that visualizes live session telemetry, usage, throughput, costs, jobs, queue state, and errors within the existing interface.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的会话状态栏，用于展示状态、模型、上下文、令牌、吞吐量、成本及任务队列等实时信息。
summaries.en: A configurable DeepSeek Harness status bar that displays live session status, model, context, token usage, throughput, cost estimates, jobs, and queue information.

capabilities: Reads DSH session telemetry and usage events
Displays configurable status, model, context, token, throughput, cost, job, queue, and error information
